content:
Tanya S.: quick help — Velox Systems wants a 6mo POC on Dedicated (2xA100 equiv) + potential prod commit. They asked for a bespoke price: 30% off list for the first 12 months if we do a POC-to-prod commit. cc @Liam R. and @Matt F., need deal-desk signoff.

Liam R.: can you drop the numbers? ARR, list, and what you're proposing exactly? need margin calc before i escalate. :eyes:

Tanya S.: baseline list for 2xA100 pool (6mo reserved): $180k. Customer asking 30% off => $126k. They also want 3 months of free support/priority onboarding. Probability to convert to 2yr prod commit: ~50%. Close window: 3 business days.

Ana G.: adding context — Velox is a target strategic account (edge infra analytics), competitor X gave them a custom 35% off for 6mo POC + add-on credits. If we want the logo and dedicated case study this quarter, we should consider a more generous POC concession.

Kevin P.: from presales - tech checklist: security questionnaire (SaaS + Dedicated) is partially done; they flagged SOC2 evidence and customer-managed KMS for Dedicated. If we give discount, we should lock a timeline for security docs to avoid delays. Also note: Dedicated provision lead time is ~3 weeks after PO.

Matt F.: high-level finance guidance — we can approve up to 20% discretionary on POC deals of this size if there is an explicit revenue commit or ROI clause. 30% requires VP approval. 20% on $180k -> $144k. Free 3mo support increases cost exposure; prefer credit instead of fully waived months. Need contract term: is the 2yr prod commit firm or conditional?

Tanya S.: proposed compromise I'm asking to approve to present: 22% off list for the 6mo Dedicated POC ($140.4k), plus $10k onboarding credit (applied if they sign prod within 90 days). If they sign a firm 2yr commit within 90 days, give an additional 5% rebate applied retroactively. Requires deal desk + legal to add the conditional rebate clause.

Liam R.: sounds reasonable. Need deal desk form filled with these items: 1) list price, 2) requested discount, 3) margin at proposed discount, 4) churn/convert assumptions, 5) approval chain. Can you paste margin calc?

Tanya S.: margin calc pasted: ```List: 180000
Requested discount: 22% -> Customer pays: 140400
Estimated infra & support cost (6mo): 38k
Gross margin est: 140400 - 38000 = 102400 -> ~57% gross margin
If rebate triggers (additional 5% -> retro pay): net rev ~131380 -> margin ~53%```

Matt F.: that margin is acceptable for a strategic logo play. Approve up to 22% with the $10k onboarding credit, provided: 1) legal adds conditional rebate clause that requires 2yr firm commit within 90 days, 2) RevOps (Liam) signs off on billing milestone for rebate, 3) security SOW milestones are tracked. I'll sign off once DealDeskBot entry is completed and Legal confirms clause language.

DealDeskBot: :information_source: To submit for Deal Desk review, please fill the form: https://redwood.internal/deal-desk and include pasted pricing table + justification. Escalation path: RevOps -> VP RevOps (if >22%) -> CFO.

Kevin P.: technical ask — include the security milestone dates in the SOW: SOC2 evidence and KMS integration must be completed within 45 days of PO or we reserve right to pause provisioning. That protects ops costs.

Ana G.: i'll push urgency with Velox to sign PO and accept the 90-day clause. Also will surface competitor's 35% offer; positioning will be product + faster SLA.

Tanya S.: thanks everyone — I'll fill the Deal Desk form now and ping Legal for the rebate clause. Putting proposed contract value: $140,400 + $10k credit (conditional). If Legal & RevOps confirm, pls react :thumbsup: and i'll send the term sheet to the customer today.

Liam R.: :thumbsup: confirm you added margin calc and the 90d clause in the form. I'll queue for approval.

Matt F.: approving in principle; await Deal Desk ticket and Legal language.

Tanya S.: (posted Deal Desk ticket #DD-2026-458) added all attachments incl. calc and security milestone. tagging @Liam R. for approval.

Liam R.: looking now. If Legal ok, I'll approve and route to VP if needed. Good work moving fast.
